The following document was recently declassified following a security breach inside Observation Room 23. Logs indicate that Dr. Evelyn Vane has exceeded multiple cognitive safety thresholds during Euphorium test trials.

The memo suggests an accelerated transformation rate among test subjects, raising new inquiries about the stability of the compound... and Vane herself.

We are currently reviewing additional surveillance footage, most of which remains corrupted. What remains... is troubling.

Expect further briefings soon.
Until then, stay out of the lower levels.
[b]- Core Personnel[/b]

notes.title: Your Therapy Begins Now.
notes.notes:
We’ve been working hard behind the scenes to craft an experience that will challenge, unsettle, and immerse you in ways you won’t expect. This is just the beginning, and we can’t wait to take you deeper into the world we’ve built.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45502907/702c33387875705ba8e9265c2119d29d09e7ea9f.gif[/img]

[h3][b]What is Project Smile?[/b][/h3]
A psychological horror experience set within the walls of a secretive facility, where twisted research, unhinged patients, and an ever-present overseer watch your every move. Will you escape? Or will you find your smile, even if it kills you?

For now, we invite you to wishlist the game and stay tuned—there’s plenty more to come.

[list]
[*] Wishlist now to stay updated
[*] Spread the word—the facility is always recruiting
[*] Await further instructions
[/list]

[i]Your therapy begins today.[/i]
